entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: exp-histogram label_replace input publishes %s row shape (%T), want %s
entries.rationale: every matched lowerExpHistogramValuedShape producer publishes chplan.HistogramRowShape, either literally as a HistogramProjection or as a Histogram-flagged VectorSetOp built by lowerExpHistogramSetOp, so this check can only ever hold

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: expression is not a known histogram-valued shape: %v
entries.rationale: labelCallOverExpHistogram admits the operand through isExpHistogramValuedShape and this lowerer consults lowerExpHistogramValuedShape for that same operand

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: %s is not a label-only histogram consumer
entries.rationale: labelCallOverExpHistogram admits only label_replace and label_join before calling lowerLabelCallOverExpHistogram

guard: default of switch call.Func.Name over [case fnLabelReplace; case fnLabelJoin; default]
